title: Tai-Ahom Janagosthi Aru Tai Parampara
author: Dr. Birendra Kumar Gohain
description: Authoritative ethnographic monograph by Dr. Birendra Kumar Gohain (former Secretary & Director of Historical and Antiquarian Studies, Assam) analyzing the historical continuity, socio-religious rituals, linguistic ties, and kinship structures connecting the Tai-Ahom, Tai Khamyang, Tai Phake, Tai Khamti, Tai Aiton, and Tai Turung communities of Northeast India.

sentences.text_roman: caw tai nai möng a sam mi pün tang pöng yu saw an lew kan
sentences.assamese_script: অসমৰ টাই জনগোষ্ঠীসমূহৰ এক উমৈহতীয়া ইতিহাস আৰু সাংস্কৃতিক পৰম্পৰা আছে
sentences.free_translation_en: The various Tai communities of Assam share a deeply unified history and common ancestral lifestyle.
sentences.free_translation_as: অসমৰ বিভিন্ন টাই জনগোষ্ঠীৰ মাজত এক গভীৰ উমৈহতীয়া ইতিহাস আৰু জীৱনধাৰা বিৰাজমান।
sentences.speaker: Dr. Birendra Kumar Gohain

sentences.free_translation_en: The Tai Khamyang people reside primarily in the historic village of Powaimukh in Tinsukia district.

sentences.assamese_script: টাই ফাকে, খামতী, আইতন আৰু তুৰুংসকল হৈছে একে নাড়ীপ্ৰোতা আত্মীয় ভাই-ককাই

sentences.notes: Detailed analysis of ancestor veneration rites.
